scope: Exercise every admitted string group-code family in the raw OBJECTS string-override route and verify allocation rollback, retry, and readback.

source.profile: One raw XRECORD with string groups 1, 3, 2, 6, and 300, plus Int32 groups 90 and 91; the string-only and combined string/Int32 APIs are exercised.

checks: All measured callback allocation failures refuse the write
The prior destination bytes remain unchanged after each failure
The complete raw source record remains unchanged after each failure
Same-codec retry reproduces byte-identical calibration output
Fresh typed raw-object readback verifies all five string groups and both Int32 values

limitations: Generated raw XRECORD transaction evidence only; no producer prevalence or semantic meaning is established for the overridden groups.
Other raw-object override variants, source profiles, and revisions remain open.
